propositions: Epic plan authors are repeating volatile graph metadata by stating the current number of children in epic descriptions.
Epic plan authors are adding redundant acceptance criteria requiring all children to be closed/completed, which duplicates deterministic enforcement.
The packaged plan-review author guide must clarify that epic descriptions should not include child count.
The packaged plan-review author guide must clarify that epics do not need a separate acceptance criterion for child closure, as this is already enforced deterministically.
